Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 l_addr_flag varchar2(1);

begin
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 
 select intl_Addr_flag into l_addr_flag -- jairam added per IM 5282
 from addresses a, sponsors s
 where s.address_id = a.address_id
 and s.SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID
 and s.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum < 2; -- IM# 5320 (not to pull more than 1 record and in the below query gave DISTINCT)
 
 if nvl(l_addr_flag, 'N') = 'N' then
 
 SELECT DISTINCT A.NAME,B.address_1||' '||
 b.street_name||' '||B.address_2||' '||
 c.city ||', '||c.state||' '|| c.zip, 
 b.d_area_code||decode(b.d_area_code,null,'','-')
 ||substr(b.d_phone_no,1,3)||decode(b.d_phone_no,null,'','-')||substr(b.d_phone_no,4,7)
 INTO :CTRL_BLOCK_1.NAME,:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address,:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_phone
 FROM SPONSORS A, ADDRESSES B, valid_city_state C
 WHERE A.SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID and
 A.address_id = B.address_id and 
 b.usps_id = c.usps_id and
 a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 --sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1);
 :local_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, to_date(:local_date)+1);
 ELSE

 begin -- jairam added below one
 
 SELECT A.INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(A.INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||A.INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(A.COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||A.COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE ), A.INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO 
 into :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address, :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_phone
 FROM ADDRESSES A, SPONSORs s 
 WHERE s.address_id = a.address_id
 and s.SPONSOR_ID =:CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID
 and a.intl_addr_flag = 'Y';
 
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 null;
 end;
 
 end if;
 
 
 
 
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.retrieve',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11047');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

if :sponsor_contacts.term_date is not null then

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 new_id varchar2(10);
 v_address_id varchar2(20);
 v_address_1 varchar2(50);
 v_street_name varchar2(50);
 v_suite_apt varchar2(10);
 v_usps_id number(6);
 v_d_area_code varchar2(5);
 v_d_phone_no varchar2(8);
 v_city varchar2(40);
 v_state varchar2(10);
 v_zip varchar2(5);
 v_eff_date date;
 
begin

 if :sponsor_contacts.contact_type is not null then
 if :sponsor_contacts.address_id is not null then
 :sponsor_contacts.address_id := :addresses.address_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 create_ids('SPCON',new_id); 
 :sponsor_contacts.contact_id := new_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.sponsor_id := :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID;
 :sponsor_contacts.insert_user := :banner.user_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.insert_date := sysdate;

 else

 select address_sequence.nextval 
 into v_address_id
 from dual ;

 :sponsor_contacts.address_id := v_address_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 create_ids('SPCON',new_id); 
 :sponsor_contacts.contact_id := new_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.sponsor_id := :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID;
 :sponsor_contacts.insert_user := :banner.user_id;
 :sponsor_contacts.insert_date := sysdate;
 v_eff_date := sysdate;

 begin

 SELECT DISTINCT B.address_1,
 B.street_name,
 B.SUITE_APT,
 B.USPS_ID,
 b.d_area_code,
 b.d_phone_no
 INTO v_address_1,
 v_street_name,
 v_suite_apt,
 v_usps_id ,
 v_d_area_code,
 v_d_phone_no
 FROM SPONSORS A, ADDRESSES B, valid_city_state C
 WHERE A.SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID and
 A.address_id = B.address_id and 
 a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and 
 :local_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, to_date(:local_date)+1) and
 b.usps_id = c.usps_id;

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 v_address_1 := '';
 v_street_name := '';
 v_suite_apt := '';
 v_usps_id := '';
 v_d_area_code := '';
 v_d_phone_no := '';
 end; 
 /* Insert the values into Addresses table*/

 insert into addresses
 (address_id,
 address_1,
 street_name,
 suite_apt,
 usps_id,
 d_area_code,
 d_phone_no,
 eff_date,
 program_id,
 insert_user,
 insert_date,
 chapter_id )
 values
 (v_address_id,
 v_address_1,
 v_street_name,
 v_suite_apt,
 v_usps_id,
 v_d_area_code,
 v_d_phone_no,
 sysdate,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :banner.user_id,
 sysdate,
 :global.chapter_id);
 
 end if; 
 

 end if;
end;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 null;--show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41008 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------
 elsif error_code = 41009 --Function key not allowed
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 41051 --Can not create records here
 then
 show_error('12038');
 ----------------------------------------------------------
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 format_error;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
